gs_read_file — DRIVE gsplat op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.gs_read_file(path, *, min_opacity: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import gsplatnp; gsplatnp.gs_read_file(path, *, min_opacity: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("gs_read_file"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Reads a 3D Gaussian Splatting file and returns the Gaussians' centers, colors, opacities, scales and orientations.

Supported: INRIA-format .ply (x, y, z, f_dc_0..2, opacity (logit), scale_0..2 (log), rot_0..3 (wxyz); the output of gsplat_train_native is also this) and .splat (32 bytes each: position 3×f32, scale 3×f32, RGBA 4×u8, rotation 4×u8 (wxyz, (q·128)+128)).

Args:

path: the file.

min_opacity: drop Gaussians with opacity below this (0 keeps all).

Returns:

{"xyz" (N,3), "rgb" (N,3) [0,1], "opacity" (N,) [0,1], "scale" (N,3)(実寸、exp 済み), "rot" (N,4) wxyz 単位四元数, "n_total", "format"}. Colour is only the 0th-order spherical harmonic (higher orders that vary with viewpoint are discarded).
